app.name: Travertine
app.tagline: Crop-rotation decisions from Earth observation data
nav.label: Main
lang.label: Language
source.demo.desc: No engine is connected. Values come from the contract fixtures for the Denizli demo field.
source.fallback.desc: The engine did not respond, so values come from the contract fixtures for the Denizli demo field.
source.live.desc: Values come from the Travertine engine.
footer.disclaimer: Travertine uses openly published Earth science data. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
home.eyebrow: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Field Shift
home.title: Plan the next five years of a field with two decades of Earth observation.
home.body: Mark a field, set what matters most and compare crop rotations scored against the climate, soil and vegetation record of that exact location.
field.title: Your field
field.intro: Search for a place, then click the map to set a point or draw the field boundary.
field.search.label: Search a place or enter coordinates
field.search.error: Search is unavailable. You can still enter coordinates.
field.search.attribution: Search by Photon, data © OpenStreetMap contributors
field.mode.label: How to mark the field
field.draw.hint: Click to add corners. Click the first corner or press Finish to close.
field.draw.hint.touch: Tap to add corners, then press Finish.
field.point.hint: Click the map to place the field centre.
field.area.point: Point only — draw a boundary to measure area
field.irrigated.desc: Turn on if this field can be irrigated. Water deficits are then shown as irrigation need.
field.basemap.label: Base map
field.map.label: Map. Use arrow keys to pan and plus or minus to zoom.
empty.title: Mark a field to begin
empty.body: Travertine needs a location to look up its climate, soil and vegetation record.
summary.title: Field summary
summary.balance.title: Rainfall and evaporative demand by year
summary.balance.subtitle: Annual precipitation vs reference evapotranspiration (ET0)
summary.balance.aria: Bar chart of annual precipitation from {from} to {to} with a line for ET0. Mean precipitation {p} mm, mean ET0 {e} mm per year.
summary.balance.gap: On average ET0 exceeds precipitation by {gap} mm a year.
summary.balance.surplus: On average precipitation exceeds ET0 by {gap} mm a year.
summary.demoMismatch: Demo data describes the Denizli demo field, not this location. Connect the engine to analyse this field.
provenance.label: Source
state.error.title: Could not analyse this field
explore.title: Explore rotations
explore.intro: Set what matters most. Rotations are re-ranked as you move the sliders.
explore.noField.title: Choose a field first
explore.noField.body: Rotations are scored against the climate and soil of a specific location.
explore.priorities.hint: Relative importance. They do not need to add up.
explore.priority.water.desc: Less irrigation need and water deficit
explore.results.note: Scores are relative rankings under your priorities, from 0 to 1. They are not yield or price forecasts.
explore.scores.aria: Scores: water {water}, income {income}, soil health {soil}, low risk {risk}. Overall {total}.
explore.why.language: Explanations are provided by the engine in English.
explore.compare.title: Side-by-side comparison
explore.compare.hint: Select two rotations to compare them side by side.
explore.empty.title: No rotations returned
explore.empty.body: The engine found no rotation for this field with the current settings. Try another horizon.
explore.error.title: Could not load rotations
explore.crops.error: Crop names could not be loaded; crop identifiers are shown instead.
chart.water.aria: Bar chart of crop water demand and deficit for each rotation year. Total demand {demand} mm, total deficit {deficit} mm.
